definitions.gloss: cerebral hemorrhage; bleeding in the brain
definitions.explanation: Bleeding inside the brain when a blood vessel bursts, often linked to high blood pressure. One of the main types of stroke ({脳卒中|のうそっちゅう}).

examples.japanese: ⟦{祖父|そふ}→祖父：01452_sofu⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{脳出血|のうしゅっけつ}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{倒|たお}れた→倒れる：01160_taoreru⟧。
examples.english: My grandfather collapsed with a cerebral hemorrhage.

examples.japanese: ⟦{高血圧|こうけつあつ}→高血圧：04415_kouketsuatsu⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{脳出血|のうしゅっけつ}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{原因|げんいん}→原因：01400_genin⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦なる→なる：01970_naru⟧。
examples.english: High blood pressure can cause cerebral hemorrhage.

examples.japanese: {脳出血|のうしゅっけつ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{起|お}こした→起こす：01234_okosu⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧、⟦{早|はや}く→早い：00514_hayai⟧⟦{治療|ちりょう}→治療：03503_chiryou⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{受|う}けた→受ける：01215_ukeru⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧で⟦{後遺症|こういしょう}→後遺症：08622_kouishou⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{軽|かる}かった→軽い：00785_karui⟧。
examples.english: He had a cerebral hemorrhage, but because he was treated quickly the aftereffects were mild.

notes:
COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {脳出血|のうしゅっけつ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{起|お}こす→起こす：01234_okosu⟧: to suffer a cerebral hemorrhage
- {脳出血|のうしゅっけつ}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{倒|たお}れる→倒れる：01160_taoreru⟧: to collapse from a cerebral hemorrhage
- {脳出血|のうしゅっけつ}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{後遺症|こういしょう}→後遺症：08622_kouishou⟧: aftereffects of a brain hemorrhage

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{脳卒中|のうそっちゅう}→脳卒中：04647_nousocchuu⟧: stroke — the umbrella term, covering {脳出血|のうしゅっけつ}, ⟦{脳梗塞|のうこうそく}→脳梗塞：31463_noukousoku⟧ (a blocked artery) and くも{膜下|まくか}⟦{出血|しゅっけつ}→出血：11735_shukketsu⟧ (subarachnoid hemorrhage)
- ⟦{脳梗塞|のうこうそく}→脳梗塞：31463_noukousoku⟧: cerebral infarction — a blockage, not a bleed
